decks.notes: The deck focuses on quickly assembling powerful equipment onto creatures like Ornithopter and Gingerbrute using creatures like Puresteel Paladin and Stoneforge Mystic. By equipping Colossus Hammer and other equipment, the deck aims to deal massive amounts of damage in a short amount of time, overwhelming opponents with a lethal combo. Utilizing cards like Blacksmith's Skill and Urza's Saga, the deck can efficiently search for key pieces and disrupt opponents' strategies. The combination of creatures, equipment, and support cards creates a fast-paced and aggressive playstyle that aims to win the game before opponents can react.

The deck focuses on quickly deploying threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler while disrupting the opponent with counterspells like Spell Snare and Counterspell. By using cheap interaction such as Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat, the deck aims to control the board and maintain tempo. The cantrips like Consider and Mishra's Bauble help to filter through the deck and find key pieces. The mana base is carefully crafted to ensure consistent access to the deck's spells. Overall, the deck aims to apply pressure while keeping the opponent off balance with its disruptive elements.

Utilizing cards like Underworld Breach, Expressive Iteration, and Dragon's Rage Channeler, this deck aims to quickly fill the graveyard, eventually casting spells from it using Underworld Breach's ability. By combining a variety of fast mana sources, cheap spells, and powerful creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, the deck can generate a significant advantage and close out games in a swift manner. With the added ability of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion, this deck is able to streamline its mana base while maintaining a powerful combo potential.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly and aggressively deal damage to your opponent using low-cost spells and creatures. By utilizing cards like Lightning Bolt, Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, and Monastery Swiftspear, the deck aims to maintain a fast-paced and relentless assault on the opponent's life total. Additionally, the inclusion of Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration helps to ensure card advantage and consistency in drawing into more threats. Overall, the key strategy is to overwhelm the opponent early on and secure a victory before they have a chance to stabilize.

This aggro deck focuses on utilizing a mix of creatures and burn spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent and deal damage efficiently. The deck runs a variety of aggressive creatures like Tarmogoyf, Nishoba Brawler, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, while also packing powerful spells like Lightning Bolt and Tribal Flames to clear the way and finish off the opponent. The inclusion of the companion Jegantha, the Wellspring adds consistency to the deck by providing an additional mana source. Overall, this deck aims to apply early pressure and maintain a strong offensive presence throughout the game.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly cast spells with Cascade abilities in order to overwhelm the opponent with high-impact cards for free. By utilizing the Cascade mechanic, the deck aims to consistently put pressure on the opponent while also disrupting their strategy with cards like Force of Negation and Brazen Borrower. The inclusion of cards like Seasoned Pyromancer and Become Immense provide additional value and flexibility to the deck, making it a formidable Aggro archetype in Modern 1 vs 1 format.

This deck focuses on utilizing various spells and creatures to quickly generate tokens and take advantage of them for explosive combos. By combining cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker, Archon of Cruelty, and Indomitable Creativity, the deck can overwhelm opponents with powerful creatures and game-changing effects. The inclusion of cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Leyline Binding provide control elements to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while utilizing Prismari Command and Lightning Bolt for removal and versatility. Overall, the deck aims to showcase creative strategies and synergies to outwit opponents in a fast-paced Modern format.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive Merfolk tribal strategy. By using a combination of effectively-costed creatures and disruptive spells, the deck aims to establish an early board presence and maintain momentum throughout the game. Cards like Lord of Atlantis and Master of the Pearl Trident boost the power of Merfolk creatures, while cards like Merfolk Trickster and Subtlety provide tempo advantage and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of Aether Vial helps to deploy creatures quickly and efficiently, maximizing the deck's aggro potential.

This deck focuses on controlling the board with removal spells and disruptive creatures, while also utilizing powerful Elemental synergies to generate value and overwhelm the opponent. Key cards like Risen Reef and Omnath, Locus of Creation provide card advantage and ramp, while Solitude and Endurance offer protection and disruption. The deck also includes versatile cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six to control the pace of the game. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue opponents and disrupt their game plan while establishing a strong board presence.

The deck aims to use Underworld Breach to enable a powerful combo with cards like Grinding Station and Thassa's Oracle to win the game quickly. Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer provide additional value and card advantage. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Teferi, Time Raveler to protect the combo and control the board. Mishra's Bauble and Mox Amber help with card filtering and mana acceleration. Urza's Saga is a versatile land that can search for key artifacts. The deck seeks to efficiently assemble its combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The deck focuses on using cards like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove to ramp up mana quickly and control the board with cards like Supreme Verdict and Prismatic Ending. The deck aims to reach the combo of casting Scapeshift to search for Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and enough mountains to deal massive damage to the opponent in one turn. The deck also utilizes cards like Bring to Light and Wrenn and Six for additional value and flexibility, while having Leyline Binding to disrupt opponents' strategies.

This deck focuses on utilizing cascade mechanics to quickly put pressure on the opponent and overwhelm them with constant threats. By casting spells with cascade, the player can effectively cheat out powerful creatures and spells while disrupting the opponent's game plan. The deck is designed to be fast and aggressive, with a mix of creatures and spells that can control the board and deal damage quickly. The inclusion of cards like Force of Negation and Blood Moon provide additional disruption and protection for the deck's strategy.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly assemble the Colossus Hammer combo by using Puresteel Paladin and Stoneforge Mystic to equip the hammer onto a creature. By using cards like Sigarda's Aid and Gingerbrute, the deck can quickly equip the hammer for a massive amount of damage in a short amount of time. The deck also includes protection and evasion cards like Giver of Runes and Inkmoth Nexus to ensure the combo goes off smoothly and efficiently. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a powerful and fast combo.

This Jeskai Control deck focuses on disruption and removal spells to control the game and outvalue the opponent. By utilizing powerful planeswalkers like Jace, the Mind Sculptor and Teferi, Hero of Dominaria, as well as counterspells and board wipes like Supreme Verdict, the deck aims to slow down the opponent's game plan and then finish them off with threats like Solitude. The inclusion of Chalice of the Void provides additional disruption, while the mana base is optimized for consistent access to the deck's powerful spells.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays with a mix of burn spells, efficient counterspells, and powerful creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent. It aims to maintain pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan with counterspells and creature removal. The deck also utilizes graveyard recursion with cards like Underworld Breach to maximize its resources. The mana base is designed to support the deck's dual-color requirements and ensure consistent casting of spells.

The deck focuses on controlling the board and disrupting the opponent's game plan with a mix of counterspells and removal spells. It aims to maintain pressure on the opponent by playing efficient threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent while also generating card advantage with cards like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration. The deck can quickly close out games by combining its aggressive creatures with burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat. The mana base is optimized for casting both blue and red spells efficiently.

The deck focuses on aggressive creature plays and utilizes a diverse mana base to support the aggressive strategy. It aims to quickly establish board presence with efficient creatures like Scion of Draco, Ragavan, and Nishoba Brawler, while using spells like Tribal Flames and Lightning Bolt for removal and reach. The inclusion of Jegantha as a companion adds flexibility to the deck's mana requirements. The deck's mix of powerful creatures and versatile spells allows it to apply pressure early and maintain it throughout the game.

This deck focuses on quick, aggressive plays using a variety of colors to maximize its effectiveness. Utilizing powerful creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Scion of Draco, along with efficient removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Tribal Flames, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of creature damage and direct damage spells. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an extra layer of versatility to the strategy, allowing for additional mana ramp and card advantage. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the diverse color requirements of the deck.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by utilizing a combination of removal spells, creature recursion, and disruptive planeswalkers. It also incorporates Elemental creatures to generate value and card advantage. The inclusion of Kaheera as a companion adds an additional layer of synergy to the Elemental theme. The mana base is carefully crafted to support all the colors necessary for the deck, with specific land choices to ensure consistency and power. Overall, the deck aims to outlast and outvalue opponents through a combination of controlling elements and elemental creatures.

The deck focuses on controlling the board with powerful elemental creatures and versatile removal spells. It leverages cards like Wrenn and Six, Teferi, Time Raveler, and Omnath, Locus of Creation to maintain card advantage and disrupt opponents' strategies. The inclusion of Elementals like Risen Reef and Solitude synergizes well with the deck's control elements, allowing for incremental advantage and protection. The deck also utilizes a lands package to ensure consistency and mana fixing, while including Kaheera, the Orphanguard as a companion to provide additional synergy with the elemental theme.

This deck focuses on using Underworld Breach and Grinding Station to create a loop that allows you to continuously mill your opponent's deck and win the game with Thassa's Oracle. It also utilizes cards like Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Mishra's Bauble to set up the combo quickly and efficiently. The inclusion of cards like Urza's Saga and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer provide additional value and card advantage to help streamline the combo. The deck aims to assemble its pieces quickly and win in a single explosive turn.

The main goal of this deck is to utilize the Underworld Breach combo with powerful artifact cards like Grinding Station and Mishra's Bauble to generate a loop that allows the player to mill their entire deck and win the game with Thassa's Oracle. Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Urza's Saga provide additional support for the combo, while cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Teferi, Time Raveler help control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The mana base is carefully crafted to ensure consistency and access to the necessary colors for the combo to go off effectively.

The deck focuses on overwhelming opponents with aggressive creatures and powerful cascade spells to quickly generate a board presence and apply pressure. By utilizing cards like Magus of the Moon and Shardless Agent, the deck aims to disrupt opponents' strategies while also maintaining a strong offensive game plan. With a mix of removal spells and versatile creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Brazen Borrower, the deck can adapt to different situations and maintain tempo. The mana base is designed to support the deck's aggressive strategy and ensure consistency in casting spells.

The deck focuses on utilizing Indomitable Creativity to cheat out powerful threats like Archon of Cruelty and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker quickly. Leyline Binding helps to protect these threats once they hit the battlefield. The deck also includes cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Prismari Command for additional control and versatility. The mana base includes a mix of fetch lands and various shock lands to ensure consistent color fixing. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of powerful creatures and disruptive spells.

This deck focuses on utilizing creatures with undying abilities and sacrifice outlets to generate value and create a combo chain that can quickly overwhelm the opponent. By tutoring for specific creatures with cards like Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution, the deck can assemble its combo pieces efficiently. The deck also uses Grist, the Hunger Tide as a versatile threat and a way to generate additional value from sacrificing creatures. Overall, the deck aims to create a toolbox of creatures to disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up its own win condition.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly assemble a powerful equipment combo using Stoneforge Mystic, Puresteel Paladin, and Colossus Hammer to create a lethal threat that can end the game in a single attack. The inclusion of cards like Gingerbrute, Ornithopter, and Springleaf Drum provide additional utility and ways to enable the combo. By tutoring for key pieces with Urza's Saga and efficiently equipping creatures, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a fast and aggressive strategy focused on dealing massive amounts of damage in a short amount of time.

This deck focuses on assembling a powerful combo using equipment like Colossus Hammer and Puresteel Paladin to quickly deal a massive amount of damage to your opponent. By utilizing cards like Stoneforge Mystic and Urza's Saga to search for key pieces, and protection from cards like Giver of Runes and Spell Pierce, this deck aims to win the game in a few decisive turns. With efficient mana production and the flexibility to switch between aggressive strategies with Ornithopter and more resilient strategies with Nettlecyst, this deck is versatile and deadly in the right hands.

The inclusion of Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration helps with card selection and keeping the momentum going. The deck also has some graveyard synergies with cards like Underworld Breach and Unholy Heat. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast, efficient threats.
